subject.title: feat(mattermost): add opt-in DM threading via dmReplyToMode

question: Should Mattermost DM threading use the new default-off `channels.mattermost.dmReplyToMode` enum contract, a narrower boolean-style option, or be deferred?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent, but adding a user-facing Mattermost channel config key changes the documented direct-message session and delivery contract, so maintainer product/API intent is required before merge.

options.title: Approve `dmReplyToMode` After Rebase
options.body: Keep the enum-shaped default-off option, require conflict resolution, and merge once the flat-default and opt-in threaded paths pass final review.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow The Knob
options.body: Ask the author to replace the enum with the maintainer-preferred boolean or per-chat-type shape before merge so docs, schema, and tests do not churn twice.

options.title: Defer DM Threading
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and pause this PR if maintainers do not want another Mattermost config surface now.

recommendation.title: Approve `dmReplyToMode` After Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the enum-shaped default-off option, require conflict resolution, and merge once the flat-default and opt-in threaded paths pass final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent flat-DM and Mattermost thread-transport history makes this the strongest available routing signal for the config/session decision.
